}}'''Void Storms''' are a form of [[Waveworn Phenomenon]] native to [[Lahai-Roi]], caused by the [[Threnodian]], [[Aleph-1]]. Void Storm activity can make local frequencies unstable with fluctuating Voidmatter Levels. 

== Archive Entries ==
{{Description|The regional Waveworn Phenomenon of Lahai-Roi that disrupts the frequencies of anything around it. It happens in a somewhat cyclical pattern.|Glossary Excerpt}} 

{{Description|A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi, erupting when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold. It indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. Before it strikes, an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning.|Glossary Excerpt}}

== Synopsis ==
Void Storms erupt when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold, causing widespread destruction within a cyclical range that disrupts the frequencies around it before those affected by it find their existence fading away from both the physical world and the memories of others. This Waveworn Phenomenon is linked to the existence of Aleph-1, that currently remains sealed, but continues to influence Lahai-Roi behind the [[Stridergate]] where it is sealed. 

Coming in cycles, or perhaps being irregular, Void Storms appear when they do and disintegrate the frequency of those living until they cease to be, being considered natural disasters for those caught up in it. Though, there are some exceptions, such as Bjartr Woods, one of the rare locations untouched by the ravages of Void Storms, or Sundermere, repelling the Void Storms which in turn also causes the Voidworm to stay clear of the area. Although, in spite of Void Storms being dangerous through it's erasure properties, the phenomenon is equally corrupting as it can make Tacet Discords highly unstable and turn humans like Clemente into Tacet Discords (Nameless Explorer) through Voidmatter contamination.

Before one strikes an atmospheric light known as the [[Shimmer]] typically appears, serving as an early warning to the residents before a Void Storm appears. 

== Effects and Properties ==
The Void Storms are a reoccurring phenomenon that endangers the land of Lahai-Roi through it's ability to erase the existence from others through contact itself. The most basic fact known in Lahai-Roi is that those consumed by the Void Storm will lose their existence until it’s forgotten entirely. This is because any living being caught within are fatally affected, losing all vitality. This is not biological death, but a dissolution of frequency itself. Form unraveling as bodies fade, becoming translucent, then silent, until they dissolve into nothing. Those who survive initial exposure find their frequency flickering like dying candlelight... until they, too, vanish from this world. If a Cassette makes it out, a record of their existence is verified. But if there are those who vanish without a Cassete Tape on them before a Void Storm, then even the fact that they died is erased, where across Lahai-Roi, or perhaps beyond, everyone have their memories altered in a way that victims consumed by the Void Storms (or a location with enough Voidmatter) are slowly forgotten by others until the memories of forgetting itself are wiped away. Aemeath is a known exception who is immune to the memory erasure as she is considered a deceased being, allowing her to recall old memories. 

Void Storms can corrupt Exoswarm, contaminating them, making them aggressive and attack others, including their own kind whist being inclined to listen to the Outcasts too a degree. Other machines such as Hyvata Detector can also be compromised and become rogue due to the Exoswarm contaminated by the Void Storm turning those afflicted by Voidmatter becoming Tacet Discords that attack ordinary Exoswarm.

This is caused by the internal system of the Exoswarm material being eroded by Voidmatter, which can cause malfunctions in the machines utilizing the parts. Students are taught this so that if they ever enact experiments, to only do so in a controlled environment since such contaminated material makes the machines inherently unstable. For safety reasons, units affected by this must be shut down where the user can clean the contaminated parts. [[Soliskin]] can also be afflicted by the Void Storm's corruption, turning them purple. Beyond the change in color, however, it is unknown how the Soliskin are affected exactly unless they are purified.

The Void Storm also has the possibility of displacing others caught in its power instead of consuming them, with one example being that enough Voidmatter concentration can allow the possibility of entering Voidspace. Although, for unknown reasons both Chisa and Sumika, instead of being erased upon being consumed by a Void Storm, instead found themselves trapped in Honami City alongside an assortment of items from Lahai-Roi, unable to escape. It is unclear on why this occurred, with no explanation if there was an external factor for this unusual displacement. At the same time, after the loops ended in Honami City, a rift opened up that allowed the Rover to enter the Lahai-Roi region after precautions were made in establishing coordinates. Though, it did hold dangers as the Rover was nearly consumed by Aleph-1, who had seemingly been waiting to consume them in the portal. It's possible this may have been the doing of Aleph-1, but is unconfirmed.

According to Hiyuki, she claims that beyond humans, structures devoured by Aleph-1 may drift off as they don't hold its interest, which causes some structures once consumed to land in [[Dimmr Plains]].

=== Voidmatter Defenses ===
Due to the inherit dangers of the Void Storm, precautions have been made in a variety of manners.

==== Casette ====
One of the most known defenses created by the institute in Lahai-Roi is the Cassete itself. Described as a ID and safety device, the Cassette is a very essential item in Lahai-Roi. They store the frequencies and memories of their user, made up of specialized equipment to defend against the Void Storms which disintegrate the frequency of any living beings. This is all so that the user’s “existence” is safeguarded and fully preserved so that those who may have been lost to the Void Storms will have some semblance of their existence known than forgotten, where they are kept safe at the Spacetrek Collective area. 

There's also the Rabelle Cassette, an identity authentication device issued by the Spacetrek Collective, serving as mandatory safety gear for navigating Lahai-Roi. All first-year students must complete the Cassette’s burning and registration under faculty supervision at the Research Institute before venturing beyond the Academy’s protected zones. Once a Cassette is burned, it means the users frequencies have been copied and transcribed into it and simply needs calibrating before being put to survive. Identical codes can sometimes cause a conflict during transcribing, but are usually handled smoothly.

There's also the Frequency Cassette Recorder. A standard Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members, designed to hold the Rabelle Cassette. Its casing is constructed from a special composite that mimics the Exostrider’s engineering, granting partial resistance to Void Storms. However, without adequate precautions, it won’t fully protect a user from the Void Storm’s effects, where many surveyors and students have had their frequencies erased this way. While some cassette's could survive, they become what [[Arsenio]] calls "Tapes of Last Words". Despite being made to resist the Void Storm’s erasure properties, if not erased the cassettes can be corrupted with the data disrupted, contaminated with Voidmatter. Only through Arsenio's abilities can the date be regained through cleaning the contamination, restoring the frequencies within properly.

==== Voidmatter Barrier ====
For more protective infrastructure, large barriers are made, such as [[Startorch Academy]] being granted a defensive barrier for the Void Storm as a defense protocol. In the academy Petrova and Halvad discuss how the Institute has developed the Antivoid Canopy by using cultivated Exostrider coating cells to resist Void Storms. By first isolating the cells from the Exostrider, developers guide and differentiate them into a massive protective mesh, which is a triumph of the Phase-Coating Sciences. Though, unlike the Exostrider’s own surface, whose cells maintain a dynamic equilibrium, thus resisting contamination and regenerate continuously, the Antivoid Canopy cannot perfectly replicate this trait. Once wear sets in, developers must manually apply newly cultivated coating cells. Though the institute believes that they can reach the same perfection as the original one day if they keep moving forward.

Thanks to this unique protection, it it set as a standard protective measure for Spacetrek Collective camps, research outposts, transit hubs, and more with the academy having the largest installation. 

==== Reactor Husk ====
The [[Reactor Husk]] is a self-defense mechanism of the Reactor Drive itself, which is on alert from any activities made by Aleph-1. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs while absorbing Voidmatter to ensure the Reactor Drive's own stability, lest it be corrupted. Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

=== Surface Voidmatter ===
The spread of Voidmatter can also affect the surface of the Roya Frostlands through Fluctuating Voidmatter Levels, being a unique phenomenon found in the surface. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian’s power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, which triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable “existence”, becoming impossible to observe directly. 

This is turn causes the need of the Module Adapter. a specialized device developed by the Spacetrek Collective for research operations in the Roya Frostlands. It forces entities with fluctuating Voidmatter levels back into the observable state for practical use. In areas with stable signal coverage, the device can be deployed directly to the user’s location. These devices detect frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter and manifests them as Adaptive Modules, allowing one to interact with frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter.

This will allow the Unstable Frequency Core, which the Module Adapter is used for shoot the Unstable Frequency Core or Unstable Barriers to switch those afflicted by the Voidmatter into the two states where that affected by the weapon become both tangible and intangible state. 

=== Voidspace ===
[[Voidspace]] is a higher-dimension that resides within Aleph-1. The realm is described as a pitch-black kaleidoscope where all that Aleph-1 has consumed now exists within this location, where time and space are in a chaotic state.  High-density Voidmatter is required for one to enter the location, which is described by [[Aemeath]] as a severe Void Storm manifesting and a portal into Voidspace itself. However, humanity is unable to enter the space as any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.

=== Voidworm ===
[[Voidworm|Voidworms]] are creatures born under the influence of Aleph-1 and the Void Storm itself. Created by the Threnodian's power through the Exoswarm material gathered and used, these creatures act as agents of the Threnodian in causing harm across the Lahai-Roi region itself. Similar to the Void Storm itself, the Voidworm is a calamity that cannot be predicted and is seen as a threat where even in their defeat, a Void Storm can allow it to function once again.

=== Voidcreeps ===
Voidcreeps are flowers that release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment, hazardous to the player and restrict movement, found in Dimmr Plains.

=== Artificial Void Storms ===
To create chaos without being seen, [[Warren]] created unsettling devices that releases an unsettling aura that causes the creation of an artificial Void Storm. Through his knowledge, Warren managed to store and amplifies a tiny slice of the Voidworm Frequency, which can cause malfunctions or corrupt technology designed from Exostrider Tech lose control  the device capable of being activated remotely. 

Upon activation, the device becomes the epicenter to spread Voidmatter across Lahai-Roi, causing great harm. More than that, Void Storms created using this method cannot be predicted by the [[Heliodic Six]], making the devices dangerous and unpredictable in the wrong hands. These devices can also lure, unintentionally, a Voidworm, which the Rover and Lynae used as bait to draw the Voidworm away from the academy.
